subject: Re: Kickoff: uniform molecule sampling as a screening data product
body:
Anders,

Resourcing.

Staffing: Saoirse 50%, Yara 60%, Wanjiru 70%. Good for all three milestones.

Compute splits in two. The sampling chain itself (stoichiometry enumeration, importance-weighted generation, rejection to uniform) is CPU-bound - we will run it on batch CPU quota, no accelerator ask. The scored library is different: property-scoring hundreds of millions of uniform samples is accelerator-heavy. For the property-scoring pass we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation - 128 accelerators - for the week of 2026-06-08, and I have built the eval schedule around that week. Ines, cc'd for awareness since Cirrus allocations are per-portfolio per quarter.

Risk to note early: rejection-to-uniform efficiency falls off as heavy-atom count grows; if acceptance rates at 8 heavy atoms are as low as Yara fears, the reference library may cap at 7. She will have measured acceptance curves by end of April.

Santiago
